question: Let $A$ be the point $(0,0)$ and let $B$ be the point $(1,0)$. A point $P$ moves so that the angle $APB$ measures $\frac{\pi}{6}$. The locus of $P$ is

options.B: arcs of two circles with centres $\left(\frac1{\sqrt2},\frac1{\sqrt2}\right)$ and $\left(\frac1{\sqrt2},-\frac1{\sqrt2}\right)$
options.C: arcs of two circles each of radius 1

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
